problem_type: workflow jobs executing repository scripts without a checked-out repository
symptom: The nightly Summarize job failed with Cannot find module scripts/nightly-walk-summary.mjs after the walkthrough batches had already produced 149 passes, 169 failures, and 6 timeouts.
direct_cause: The report job downloaded artifacts but did not run actions/checkout before invoking a repository-relative Node script.
class_root: There was no repository-wide workflow invariant or test requiring checkout before any job run step that references scripts/.
affected_population: Any current or future workflow job that executes a repository-relative scripts/ file
internal_only_reason: This is an internal repository workflow invariant; no third-party behavior decides whether a checked-out repository is required before a repository-relative script runs.
invariants: Every workflow job step that runs a scripts/ file has an earlier actions/checkout step.
Nightly CI selection is derived from the reviewed B-category registry rather than an unreviewed find-all list.
The report job has the Node runtime required by its repository script.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The workflow test is the shared merge boundary for every workflow YAML, while the selector test owns the nightly B-registry invariant.

door_reduction.why_not: The two readRows consumers are separate report-producing workflows and must remain independently callable; updateIssue is the sole issue-writing boundary. The fix adds workflow enforcement around these doors rather than merging their responsibilities.

generality_proof: The workflow test scans every YAML workflow and every run step, so a new job or workflow that invokes scripts/ without checkout fails before merge. The nightly selector centralizes the B-category decision in data and is covered by a class-level test.

shared_boundaries.symbol: every workflow job that runs a repository script checks out the repository first
shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject every workflow job that executes a repository-relative scripts/ file before checkout.
Apply the reviewed B-category exclusion registry to every nightly walk selection.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: This was the reported missing-checkout entry; checkout and setup-node now precede the summary script.
The batch job already checked out first; the repository-wide test now protects that invariant for future edits.
This is a separate local walkthrough consumer of the shared helper, not a GitHub Actions job, so the workflow checkout invariant does not govern it.

recurrence.reason: Any workflow can reproduce the same module-not-found failure whenever it calls a repository-relative script without checkout; the original report job already demonstrated that the failure can hide a large batch result.
same_class_scan: Scanned every .github/workflows/*.yml and *.yaml job run step for scripts/ references.
Checked both nightly batch and report entry points.
Ran node scripts/door-map.mjs readRows updateIssue --roots=scripts,.github,.github/workflows --include-tests; it found the three shared summary doors recorded above.

prevention.invariant: A workflow job may not run a repository-relative scripts/ file until an actions/checkout step has executed earlier in that job.
prevention.failure_mode: The node:test assertion fails with the offending workflow, job, and step index before merge.
prevention.strategy: Keep the production workflow explicit and use one cross-workflow assertion as the shared gate; no per-workflow allowlist is permitted.

legacy_paths.rationale: The unreviewed find-all selection in this workflow was replaced by the registry-backed selector in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls the checkout invariant; actions/checkout and setup-node are workflow primitives used directly.

migration: Existing workflows require no data migration. Future B-category walkthroughs are added to tests/ux/nightly-ci-exclusions.json and are then excluded by the shared selector.
residual_risks: The 25 D-category entries remain unmodified pending independent product reproduction; their evidence and paths are listed in docs/research/2026-10-08-nightly-walk-triage.md.
The six timed-out walks remain C-category evidence; this branch fixes the shared report checkout and selection boundary but does not tune individual walk timeouts.
